verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Automations that run the Copilot cloud agent automatically on a schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened [15][33]. The cloud agent works independently in the background to plan, explore and execute tasks [3][31], and a centralized page tracks agent sessions and progress [14]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations work as described, and detailed documentation of trigger types and configuration beyond the brief schedule/event mention.
